source: ASTRA Health AI working copy, FlexArray-MN V2.1 with the 45-second guided demo revision. The source is not a git repository, so there is no source commit; per-file SHA-256 values are in MANIFEST.sha256 inside the ZIP.

contents.frontend: React 18 + TypeScript + Vite source, unit and Playwright browser tests, pnpm and npm lockfiles, prebuilt dist/
contents.backend: FastAPI + SQLite code and tests; optional, only for the full ASTRA app (--full)
contents.assets/3d: 6 GLB models (presentation and engineering scale) and 4 preview images
contents.docs: demo, bay and redesign notes with screenshots

verification.npm_ci_and_pnpm_frozen_install: both rebuild dist byte-identical to the shipped dist (11/11 files)
verification.unit_tests: 64/64; typecheck OK; GLB re-import validator passed

scope: Independent demo. No runtime dependency on, and no changes to, the Next.js app, HUD, Station, Relay, contracts or astra-patch/.
